To compare the prices of three different travel kits
To announce a revised warranty policy for customers
To request approval for an increase in the department budget
why: 正解：備忘錄比較三家候選廠商，並說明訂單將決標給哈爾登的理由。
被比較的是三家廠商的轉接器，並非三種旅行組合。
終身保固是哈爾登產品的條件，而非公司對客戶修改的保固政策。
文中沒有提到預算增加或需要核准預算。

questions.q: What must happen before the order is finalized?
opts: The distribution partner in Osaka must approve the choice.
Customers must register the product within thirty days.
Halden's samples must pass a test by March 14.
Korvex Components must lower its quotation.
why: 大阪的夥伴只是提供引薦，文中沒有說需要他們核准。
三十天內註冊是保固生效的條件，並非決標前的要求。
正解：訂單將決標給哈爾登，但須以三月十四日前通過樣品測試為前提。
科維克斯雖然報價最低，但文中沒有要求它降價，而是因可靠度疑慮未被選用。

questions.q: What is implied about Korvex Components' adapters?
opts: They were recommended by the Osaka partner.
They are less expensive but possibly less durable.
They cannot be used in the target markets.
why: 引薦來自大阪夥伴，但文中沒有說是引薦科維克斯，且與此題推論無關。
正解：科維克斯報價最低，但使用通用內部零件，工程報告指出可能降低反覆使用下的可靠度。
終身保固是哈爾登的產品條件，並非科維克斯。
相容性是挑選時的要求，文中並未說科維克斯的產品無法在目標市場使用。

questions.q: The supplier has agreed to ______ the defective units at no additional charge.
why: replacement 是名詞，agree to 後面要接原形動詞作不定詞。
replaced 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在不定詞 to 之後。
replacing 是動名詞，agreed to 作為不定詞時後面不接 -ing。
正解：agreed to 之後接原形動詞 replace，表示同意免費更換瑕疵品。

questions.q: The shipment was delayed ______ a customs inspection at the port.
why: 正解：because of 是複合介系詞，後面接名詞片語 a customs inspection，表示原因。
because 是連接詞，後面要接完整子句，不能直接接名詞片語。
although 是連接詞，表示讓步，且後面也要接子句。
even though 同樣是連接詞，語意與結構都不符。

questions.q: The purchasing department places great emphasis on supplier ______.
why: rely 是動詞，介系詞 on 之後需要名詞，不能接動詞。
reliable 是形容詞，後面沒有名詞可以修飾，無法單獨作 on 的受詞。
正解：reliability 是名詞，作為介系詞 on 的受詞，supplier 修飾它，指「供應商的可靠度」。
reliably 是副詞，不能作介系詞的受詞。

extra_vocab.en: the act of telling someone about a person or company that can help them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a referral from our distribution partner 指由大阪經銷夥伴「介紹」了一批候選供應商。referral 常用於商務上的推薦、引介，也可指推薦人或被推薦的對象。

example.en: Our referral program gives customers a discount for each new client.
example.zh: 我們的推薦計畫會為每位新客戶提供顧客折扣。

example.en: The agency charges a small referral fee for each introduction.
example.zh: 這家仲介公司每介紹一位就收取少許引薦費。

example.en: We received a referral from an existing client last week.
example.zh: 我們上週收到一位現有客戶的推薦。

example.en: New members can join only by referral at this time.
example.zh: 目前新會員只能透過推薦加入。

examples.en: We found the new supplier through a referral from a colleague.
examples.zh: 我們透過一位同事的推薦找到了新供應商。

examples.en: Many companies hire new staff through employee referrals.
examples.zh: 許多公司透過員工推薦來招聘新人。

examples.en: Customer referrals help us find new clients without extra advertising.
examples.zh: 客戶推薦幫助我們不用額外打廣告就找到新客戶。

confusable.diff: reference 是「參考資料」或「推薦信、介紹人」；referral 指「把人或業務介紹給別人」這個動作或其結果。
recommendation 是一般的「建議、推薦」；referral 多指把客戶、病人或供應商正式介紹給另一方。

example.en: Please refer to the attached file for more details.
example.zh: 更多細節請參閱附件。

example.en: The applicant listed two references on his résumé.
example.zh: 應徵者在履歷上列了兩位推薦人。

example.en: I recommend that we choose the second supplier.
example.zh: 我建議我們選擇第二家供應商。

extra_vocab.zh: 通用的、無品牌的、一般性的
extra_vocab.en: not special; without a brand name or a particular design
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，generic internal parts 指沒有特定品牌、非專屬設計的通用內部零件，言下之意是品質與可靠度較普通。generic 常帶有「沒有特色、不特別」的語感。

example.en: Some stores sell generic brand products at lower prices.
example.zh: 有些商店以較低的價格販售無品牌商品。

example.en: The hospital switched to a generic drug to save money.
example.zh: 醫院改用學名藥以節省經費。

example.en: "Software" is a generic term for computer programs.
example.zh: 「軟體」是電腦程式的通稱。

examples.en: The email sounded generic, so many readers ignored it.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件聽起來很制式，所以許多讀者都忽略了它。

examples.en: Generic parts are cheaper, but they may not last as long.
examples.zh: 通用零件比較便宜，但可能用不了那麼久。

examples.en: Please avoid generic answers and give specific examples instead.
examples.zh: 請避免籠統的回答，改為提出具體的例子。

confusable.diff: general 是「一般的、大致的、整體的」；generic 指「通用的、無特定品牌或特色的」，常用於商品與零件。

example.en: The general manager will lead the meeting.
example.zh: 總經理將主持這場會議。

example.en: Orders are generally delivered within three days.
example.zh: 訂單通常在三天內送達。

extra_vocab.en: the whole time that a person lives or a product works
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，lifetime warranty 是「終身保固」，指只要產品還在使用期間內都提供保固。lifetime 放在名詞前當形容詞用，常見於保固、會員資格與獎項。

example.en: Every chair we sell comes with a lifetime warranty.
example.zh: 我們賣出的每張椅子都附終身保固。

example.en: He bought a lifetime membership at the business club.
example.zh: 他在商務俱樂部購買了終身會員資格。

example.en: The tool carries a lifetime guarantee against defects.
example.zh: 這項工具附有針對瑕疵的終身保證。

example.en: We track customer lifetime value to plan our marketing budget.
example.zh: 我們追蹤客戶終身價值來規劃行銷預算。

examples.en: The battery has a lifetime of about five years.
examples.zh: 這顆電池的使用壽命約為五年。

examples.en: The machine's lifetime depends on how often it is used.
examples.zh: 這台機器的使用壽命取決於使用的頻率。

examples.en: She received a lifetime achievement award at the conference.
examples.zh: 她在研討會上獲頒終身成就獎。

confusable.diff: lifelong 是形容詞，指「一輩子的」（如 lifelong friend）；lifetime 可當名詞「一生」，也可當形容詞放在名詞前（如 lifetime warranty）。

example.en: Regular cleaning can extend the life of the equipment.
example.zh: 定期清潔可以延長設備的壽命。

example.en: Learning is a lifelong process for every employee.
example.zh: 對每位員工來說，學習都是終身的過程。

extra_vocab.en: the part that you put into a wall outlet to get electricity
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，plug 是名詞，指充電轉接器的「插頭」，所以 every plug 是每一個插頭（每件產品）。plug 也常當動詞，plug in 表示接上電源。

example.en: This power plug is designed for use in three countries.
example.zh: 這款電源插頭是為三個國家的使用而設計的。

example.en: Please plug in the printer and press the start button.
example.zh: 請接上印表機的電源並按下開始鍵。

example.en: Bring a plug adapter if you travel to Portugal.
example.zh: 如果你要去葡萄牙出差，請帶一個轉接插頭。

examples.en: Please plug the projector into the wall outlet before the meeting.
examples.zh: 請在會議開始前把投影機插到牆上的插座。

examples.en: You need a travel plug to charge your laptop in Europe.
examples.zh: 你在歐洲幫筆電充電需要一個旅行用插頭。

examples.en: Always pull out the plug before cleaning the machine.
examples.zh: 清潔機器前請務必先拔掉插頭。

confusable.diff: outlet（美式）指牆上的「插座」，是插頭插進去的地方；plug 是「插頭」，是插進插座的那一端。
socket 也是「插座」（英式較常用，也指燈座）；plug 是插入的「插頭」。

example.en: Please unplug the device before you leave the office.
example.zh: 離開辦公室前請先拔掉這台裝置的插頭。

example.en: There is no outlet near my desk.
example.zh: 我的辦公桌附近沒有插座。

example.en: The socket in the meeting room does not work.
example.zh: 會議室裡的插座壞了。

example.en: I left my phone charger at the hotel.
example.zh: 我把手機充電器忘在飯店了。

extra_vocab.en: able to work or be used together with something else
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the plugs must be compatible with outlets 指插頭必須能配合四個目標市場的插座規格使用。compatible 後面通常接 with，常見於設備、軟體與規格的相容性。

example.en: The new tablet is fully compatible with our current system.
example.zh: 新的平板電腦與我們目前的系統完全相容。

example.en: The app can be installed on all compatible devices.
example.zh: 這款應用程式可以安裝在所有相容的裝置上。

example.en: Please check that the new software is compatible with existing systems.
example.zh: 請確認新軟體與現有系統相容。

examples.en: Make sure the charger is compatible with your phone model.
examples.zh: 請確認這個充電器與你的手機型號相容。

examples.en: Our devices are compatible with most operating systems.
examples.zh: 我們的裝置與大多數作業系統相容。

examples.en: The two managers have compatible working styles.
examples.zh: 這兩位經理的工作風格很合得來。

confusable.diff: suitable 是「適合的」，指適合某目的或場合；compatible 是「能一起運作、相容的」，強調兩者能配合。

example.en: We tested the compatibility of the software before launch.
example.zh: 我們在上市前測試了軟體的相容性。

example.en: The old files are incompatible with the new program.
example.zh: 舊檔案與新程式不相容。

example.en: An adapter lets you use the plug in other countries.
example.zh: 轉接器讓你能在其他國家使用這個插頭。

items.tag: 新品運動襪行銷企劃書（素人體驗推廣）

level.why: 企劃書使用 following、Rather than、although 與 which 非限定子句，搭配被動與條件式預算釋出規則，需整合上次成效不佳的原因、新推廣對象、招募人數與期程、報酬安排及預算條件。干擾項取自文中出現過的做法與數字（購買廣告版位、六週測試、六月十二日報告），需精確區分。

items.passage:
CAMPAIGN BRIEF: Stridewell Performance Socks

Following disappointing results from last spring's launch, the marketing team proposes shifting the campaign away from mass promotional messages, which many subscribers reportedly treated as spam, and toward community-based outreach among amateur runners. Rather than purchasing additional advertising space, Stridewell will invest in the recruitment of fifty local running club members, who will be asked to test the new socks for six weeks and to share honest reviews on social media.

Participants will keep the products at no charge, although they will not be paid for their posts. A preliminary report on engagement is due on June 12, and the remaining budget will be released only if the sign-up rate among subscribers rises by at least ten percent.
items.zh:
活動企劃書：Stridewell 高效能運動襪

鑑於去年春季上市的成效不如預期，行銷團隊建議調整活動方向，不再大量發送促銷訊息（許多訂閱者據說將這些訊息當成垃圾郵件），改為在業餘跑者之間進行社群導向的推廣。Stridewell 不會再購買額外的廣告版位，而是投入資源招募五十位當地路跑社團成員，邀請他們試穿新款襪子六週，並在社群媒體上分享真實的使用心得。

參與者可免費保留試用的產品，但不會因發文而獲得酬勞。關於參與度的初步報告須在 6 月 12 日提交，只有在訂閱者的註冊率至少成長百分之十的情況下，剩餘預算才會被釋出。

vocab.col: a pair of socks / athletic sock

questions.q: What change does the marketing team propose?
opts: Increasing the number of promotional messages sent to subscribers
Buying more advertising space in running magazines
Engaging amateur runners instead of relying on mass promotions
Redesigning the socks after negative customer reviews
why: 提案是要減少大量促銷訊息，因為許多訂閱者把它們當成垃圾郵件，並非增加。
文中說 Rather than purchasing additional advertising space，也就是不再購買廣告版位。
正解：提案是從大量促銷訊息轉向在業餘跑者之間進行社群導向的推廣。
文中沒有提到要重新設計襪子，問題出在上次的推廣方式。

questions.q: What is indicated about the participants?
opts: They will keep the socks they test.
They will be paid for each social media post.
They will purchase the socks at a discount.
They will be hired as full-time employees.
why: 正解：Participants will keep the products at no charge，也就是免費保留試用的產品。
文中明確說他們不會因為發文而獲得酬勞。
參與者是免費保留產品，並不是以折扣價購買。
recruitment 指的是招募試用者，並非聘僱為正式員工。

questions.q: Under what condition will the remaining budget be released?
opts: If the preliminary report is submitted by June 12
If the sign-up rate among subscribers increases by at least ten percent
If all fifty participants complete the six-week test
If the results match those of last spring's launch
why: 六月十二日是初步報告的繳交期限，並非釋出預算的條件。
正解：只有在訂閱者的註冊率至少成長百分之十時，剩餘預算才會被釋出。
六週是試用期間，文中沒有說需要全部五十人完成才釋出預算。
上次春季上市的結果不理想，不可能以重現那樣的結果作為條件。

questions.q: Sales representatives are responsible ______ handling customer inquiries within one business day.
why: be responsible of 不是正確搭配，應使用 for。
at 通常表示地點或時間點，不能與 responsible 搭配表示負責的事項。
on 與 responsible 的搭配不成立，語意也不通。
正解：be responsible for 表示「負責……」，後面接動名詞 handling。

questions.q: The promotion is ______ to customers who have registered for the loyalty program.
why: avail 是動詞，意為「有益於」，放在 is 之後無法構成句意。
availably 不是正確的字，也不能作為 be 動詞後的補語。
正解：available 是形容詞，與 is 搭配，available to 表示「可供……使用」。
availability 是名詞，與 is 搭配後語意不通。

questions.q: Customer satisfaction scores have improved ______ since the new return policy was introduced.
why: 正解：significantly 是副詞，修飾動詞 have improved，表示明顯進步。
significant 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 improved。
signify 是動詞，句中已有動詞，不能再接一個動詞。
significance 是名詞，不能修飾動詞，語意也不通。

extra_vocab.en: a person who runs, for sport or for exercise
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，amateur runners 指業餘跑者，是這款運動襪的目標客群，也就是行銷團隊想透過社群方式接觸的對象。runner 在運動品牌行銷中很常見，用來指有跑步習慣的消費者。

example.en: The race attracted thousands of amateur runners from nearby cities.
example.zh: 這場路跑吸引了來自鄰近城市的數千名業餘跑者。

example.en: Our new shoes were tested by a professional marathon runner.
example.zh: 我們的新鞋由一位職業馬拉松跑者測試過。

example.en: This sports drink is designed for long-distance runners.
example.zh: 這款運動飲料是為長跑選手設計的。

collocations.zh: 領先者、最有希望的人選

example.en: Halden Electric is the front-runner for the supply contract.
example.zh: 哈爾登電機是這份供貨合約最有希望的人選。

examples.en: Many runners prefer lightweight socks that stay dry during long runs.
examples.zh: 許多跑者偏好長跑時能保持乾爽的輕量襪子。

examples.en: Local runners will gather at the park for Saturday's charity event.
examples.zh: 當地跑者將在週六的公益活動中聚集在公園。

examples.en: The store hosts a weekly meeting for runners of all levels.
examples.zh: 這家店每週為各種程度的跑者舉辦聚會。

confusable.diff: jogger 指以較慢速度輕鬆慢跑的人；runner 範圍更廣，包含一般跑者、比賽選手與長跑運動員。
racer 專指參加比賽的人（也可指賽車手）；runner 不一定參加比賽，只要有跑步習慣就可以稱為 runner。

example.en: Our club runs together every Sunday morning.
example.zh: 我們社團每週日早上一起跑步。

example.en: Running has become more popular among office workers.
example.zh: 跑步在上班族之間越來越受歡迎。

example.en: The company sponsors a ten-kilometer race each year.
example.zh: 公司每年贊助一場十公里路跑。

extra_vocab.en: a piece of clothing that you wear on your foot inside a shoe
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，Stridewell Performance Socks 是活動主角：一款高效能運動襪。sock 是可數名詞，通常用複數 socks，因為襪子是成雙的，常說 a pair of socks。

example.en: Each customer will receive a pair of socks as a gift.
example.zh: 每位顧客都會收到一雙襪子當作贈品。

example.en: Athletic socks should be soft and keep your feet dry.
example.zh: 運動襪應該柔軟並能保持雙腳乾爽。

example.en: Wool socks sell best in the winter months.
example.zh: 羊毛襪在冬季銷量最好。

example.en: We now offer ankle socks in five different colors.
example.zh: 我們現在提供五種顏色的短襪。

examples.en: Socks are placed near the checkout counter to encourage extra sales.
examples.zh: 襪子擺在結帳櫃台附近，以促進額外銷售。

examples.en: These socks are made from a material that absorbs sweat quickly.
examples.zh: 這些襪子的材質能快速吸汗。

examples.en: Please send us ten dozen socks in assorted sizes.
examples.zh: 請寄給我們十打各種尺寸的襪子。

confusable.diff: stocking 通常指較長、較薄的長襪（如女用絲襪）或聖誕襪；sock 是一般日常與運動穿的襪子。
tights 是緊身褲襪，從腰部一直覆蓋到腳；sock 只包覆腳部到小腿。

example.en: The running shoe comes with a free pair of socks.
example.zh: 這款跑鞋附贈一雙襪子。

example.en: The company sells footwear for hiking and running.
example.zh: 這家公司販售登山與跑步用的鞋類。

example.en: Sports apparel makes up most of our online sales.
example.zh: 運動服飾占了我們線上銷售的大部分。

extra_vocab.en: unwanted messages, often advertisements, sent to many people
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，treated as spam 表示許多訂閱者把公司寄出的大量促銷訊息當成垃圾郵件，這也是上次行銷成效不佳的原因。spam 是不可數名詞，也可當動詞，指大量寄送不受歡迎的訊息。

example.en: Our newsletter was blocked by the customer's spam filter.
example.zh: 我們的電子報被客戶的垃圾郵件過濾器擋下了。

example.en: Please check your spam folder if you do not see our reply.
example.zh: 如果沒有看到我們的回覆，請檢查您的垃圾郵件匣。

example.en: Too many customers marked the message as spam.
example.zh: 太多顧客把這封訊息標示為垃圾郵件。

example.en: We receive hundreds of spam emails every day.
example.zh: 我們每天都會收到數百封垃圾電子郵件。

examples.en: Sending too many offers can make customers see your brand as spam.
examples.zh: 寄送太多優惠，可能讓顧客把你的品牌視為垃圾訊息。

examples.en: Do not open attachments in spam messages from unknown senders.
examples.zh: 請勿開啟不明寄件者寄來的垃圾訊息中的附件。

examples.en: Our reply may have ended up in your spam folder.
examples.zh: 我們的回覆可能被歸到您的垃圾郵件匣了。

confusable.diff: junk mail 指不想要的廣告信，可以是紙本郵件，也可指電子郵件；spam 主要指大量寄發的電子垃圾訊息。
phishing 是假冒身分騙取帳號或金錢的詐騙郵件，具有詐騙意圖；spam 只是不受歡迎的大量廣告，不一定是詐騙。

example.en: The email filter blocks most unwanted messages.
example.zh: 電子郵件過濾器會擋下大部分不想要的訊息。

example.en: Please delete the junk in your inbox.
example.zh: 請刪除你收件匣裡的垃圾郵件。

example.en: You can block messages from unknown senders.
example.zh: 你可以封鎖不明寄件者的訊息。

extra_vocab.en: the process of finding and choosing people to join a company or a project
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，the recruitment of fifty local running club members 指招募五十位跑步社團成員來試穿並分享心得，並不是聘雇員工。recruitment 除了用在人才招聘，也可用在招募參與者、志工或試用者。

example.en: The firm launched a recruitment campaign for new sales staff.
example.zh: 公司為新進業務人員展開了招募活動。

example.en: We hired a recruitment agency to find an engineer.
example.zh: 我們聘請人力仲介公司來尋找工程師。

example.en: The recruitment process usually takes about six weeks.
example.zh: 招募流程通常需要大約六週。

example.en: The recruitment of volunteers will begin next month.
example.zh: 志工的招募將在下個月開始。

examples.en: Recruitment costs rose sharply because the job market was competitive.
examples.zh: 由於就業市場競爭激烈，招募成本大幅上升。

examples.en: Recruitment of brand ambassadors helped us reach younger customers.
examples.zh: 招募品牌大使幫助我們接觸到更年輕的顧客。

examples.en: The HR team will present its recruitment plan on Friday.
examples.zh: 人資團隊將在週五提出招募計畫。

confusable.diff: hiring 指最後決定錄用並簽約僱用人員；recruitment 指尋找、吸引並挑選人選的整個過程，範圍較廣。
employment 指受僱的狀態或工作機會（employment contract）；recruitment 指找人與招募的行為。

example.en: We plan to recruit ten new employees this year.
example.zh: 我們計畫今年招募十名新員工。

example.en: A recruiter called me about a job in marketing.
example.zh: 一位招募人員打電話告訴我一個行銷職缺。

example.en: Each applicant must submit a résumé online.
example.zh: 每位應徵者都必須在線上提交履歷。

extra_vocab.en: a person who pays or signs up to receive a service or messages regularly
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章中，subscribers 指訂閱公司電子報或促銷訊息的顧客，也是剩餘預算釋出的衡量指標：subscribers 的註冊率要成長至少百分之十。subscriber 在行銷與媒體領域常用來描述有訂閱關係的顧客。

example.en: Newsletter subscribers will receive the discount code first.
example.zh: 電子報訂閱者會最先收到折扣碼。

example.en: Every new subscriber gets a free trial for thirty days.
example.zh: 每位新訂戶都可享有三十天的免費試用。

example.en: The service has built a subscriber base of two million users.
example.zh: 這項服務已累積了兩百萬名使用者的訂戶群。

example.en: The number of paying subscribers grew by ten percent.
example.zh: 付費訂戶的人數成長了百分之十。

examples.en: Our subscribers are more likely to buy than other visitors.
examples.zh: 我們的訂閱者比其他訪客更有可能購買。

examples.en: Subscribers can cancel their plan at any time on the website.
examples.zh: 訂閱者可以隨時在網站上取消方案。

examples.en: We need to increase the number of subscribers before the next launch.
examples.zh: 我們必須在下一次上市之前增加訂閱者人數。

confusable.diff: member 指屬於某組織、俱樂部或會員制度的人，不一定是定期收到內容；subscriber 強調訂閱某項服務或內容。
customer 指購買商品或服務的顧客；subscriber 指有訂閱關係、持續接收內容或服務的人，不一定每次都購買。

example.en: Click here to subscribe to our monthly newsletter.
example.zh: 點擊這裡訂閱我們的月電子報。

example.en: Your subscription will renew automatically next month.
example.zh: 您的訂閱將在下個月自動續訂。

example.en: You may unsubscribe from these emails at any time.
example.zh: 您可以隨時取消訂閱這些電子郵件。

items.tag: 服務合約修訂通知（費用調降與中斷補償）

level.why: 合約修訂通知含 in exchange for which、which will be capped、failing which 等關係子句與被動結構，並需整合費用、支援次數上限、中斷補償的計算方式與通報義務等多項條款。干擾項取自文中出現過的數字與處理方式（現金退款、費用調降、支援次數），需精確區分。

items.passage:
NOTICE OF CONTRACT AMENDMENT

Effective November 1, the service agreement between Brightline Hosting and Marlow Associates will be amended in three respects. First, the monthly fee will be reduced to 4,800 dollars, in exchange for which Marlow Associates will give up its right to unlimited on-site support visits, which will be capped at six per year. Second, any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours will entitle the client to a credit, which will be deducted from the following month's invoice rather than refunded in cash. Third, Brightline must alert the finance department within twenty-four hours of any outage, failing which the credit will be doubled.

All other provisions remain unchanged. Both parties are asked to sign and return the enclosed addendum by October 23.
items.zh:
合約修訂通知

自 11 月 1 日起，Brightline 主機代管公司與 Marlow 顧問公司之間的服務協議將在三方面進行修訂。第一，月費將降為 4,800 美元，作為交換，Marlow 顧問公司將放棄無限次現場支援服務的權利，現場支援將限制為每年六次。第二，任何持續超過連續四小時的服務中斷，客戶都有權獲得一筆抵用額，該金額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。第三，Brightline 必須在任何當機事件發生後二十四小時內通知財務部門，否則抵用額將加倍。

其他所有條款維持不變。請雙方於 10 月 23 日前簽署並寄回隨附的附加條款。

vocab.col: deduct from payment / deduct a fee
alert the staff / alert someone to a problem
entitle someone to a refund / be entitled to

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To request payment of an overdue invoice
To inform a client of revisions to a service agreement
To announce the opening of a new support center
To propose ending the contract early
why: 文中提到的是下個月發票的抵扣，並沒有要求支付逾期款項。
正解：通知說明服務協議將在費用、支援次數與中斷補償等三方面修訂。
文中完全沒有提到新設支援中心，只有現場支援次數的限制。
通知是要雙方簽署附加條款，其他條款維持不變，並非提前終止合約。

questions.q: How will a credit for a long outage be applied?
opts: It will be refunded in cash within a month.
It will be applied to the annual support visits.
It will be added to the fee for the next quarter.
It will be subtracted from the next invoice.
why: 文中明確說抵用額不是以現金退還，而是從發票扣除。
每年六次的現場支援與抵用額無關，兩者是不同的條款。
抵用額是減少費用，而不是增加下一季的費用。
正解：抵用額將從下個月的發票中扣除，而不是以現金退還。

questions.q: What will happen if Brightline fails to report an outage within twenty-four hours?
opts: The credit given to the client will be doubled.
The monthly fee will be reduced further.
The number of support visits will increase.
why: 正解：failing which 指未在二十四小時內通報，抵用額將加倍。
月費調降是此次修訂的第一項內容，與未通報的後果無關。
文中沒有提到未通報會終止協議。
現場支援次數是被限制為每年六次，並不會因為未通報而增加。

questions.q: The finance team requested that all expense reports ______ before the end of the month.
why: 主詞 expense reports 是被提交的對象，使用主動的 submit 語意不通。
submits 是第三人稱單數，與複數主詞不一致，且語態也不對。
正解：request that 之後的子句用假設語氣，動詞為 (should) be + 過去分詞，這裡報告是被提交，所以用 be submitted。
submitting 是現在分詞，不能單獨作為子句的動詞。

questions.q: The contractor is ______ for any damages caused by delays in completing the work.
why: liability 是名詞，放在 be 動詞之後不能與 for 構成「負責」的語意。
正解：be liable for 表示「對……負責」，liable 是形容詞，與 is 搭配。
liably 不是常用字，也不能作為 be 動詞後的補語。
liabilities 是名詞複數，與單數主詞和語意都不符。

questions.q: Please review the contract carefully ______ signing it.
why: although 表示讓步，「儘管簽署」語意不符合提醒仔細閱讀合約的目的。
despite 是介系詞，意為「儘管」，語意上不合理。
unless 是「除非」，後面接 signing it 結構與語意都不通。
正解：before signing 表示「簽署之前」，符合提醒先仔細閱讀合約的語意。

extra_vocab.en: without any limit on how much or how many
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，unlimited on-site support visits 指客戶原本享有「不限次數」的到場支援服務，修訂後改為每年最多六次。unlimited 常見於合約與方案條款中，用來說明次數、用量或存取沒有上限。

forms.label: 過去式／過去分詞／形容詞

example.en: Members get unlimited access to all our training videos.
example.zh: 會員可以不限次數觀看我們所有的培訓影片。

example.en: This phone plan comes with unlimited data every month.
example.zh: 這個手機方案每個月都提供無限流量。

example.en: You can invite an unlimited number of guests to the webinar.
example.zh: 你可以邀請不限人數的來賓參加這場網路研討會。

examples.en: The plan gives you unlimited storage for all your company files.
examples.zh: 這個方案提供無限的儲存空間，讓你存放所有公司檔案。

examples.en: The package includes unlimited phone support for one full year.
examples.zh: 這個套裝方案包含為期一整年、不限次數的電話支援。

examples.en: Our company does not have an unlimited budget for travel.
examples.zh: 我們公司的差旅預算並不是沒有上限的。

confusable.diff: limitless 也是「無限的」，語氣較文學、較誇張，多形容可能性或潛力；unlimited 常用於合約、方案中的次數與用量。
unrestricted 強調「不受規定限制」（如不受限制的進出）；unlimited 強調「數量或次數沒有上限」。

example.en: We have to limit the number of guests to fifty.
example.zh: 我們必須把賓客人數限制在五十人以內。

example.en: We have limited time to finish the report.
example.zh: 我們完成報告的時間有限。

example.en: The contract has a limitation on the number of visits.
example.zh: 合約對到訪次數設有限制。

extra_vocab.en: a problem that stops something from continuing in the normal way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，any disruption lasting longer than four consecutive hours 指服務「中斷」超過連續四小時，客戶就能獲得補償點數。disruption 指讓正常運作被打亂或停止的問題，常用於服務、交通與生產。

example.en: The system update may cause disruption to online orders.
example.zh: 系統更新可能會對線上訂單造成中斷。

example.en: We will work at night to minimize disruption to customers.
example.zh: 我們會在夜間作業，把對客戶的干擾降到最低。

example.en: A service disruption lasted three hours yesterday morning.
example.zh: 昨天早上發生了持續三小時的服務中斷。

example.en: The move to the new office took place with minimal disruption.
example.zh: 搬到新辦公室的過程幾乎沒有造成干擾。

examples.en: Heavy snow led to serious disruption of flights across the region.
examples.zh: 大雪使整個地區的航班嚴重受到影響。

examples.en: A supply disruption forced the factory to stop work for two days.
examples.zh: 供應中斷迫使工廠停工兩天。

examples.en: Construction next door may be a disruption to our afternoon meeting.
examples.zh: 隔壁的施工可能會干擾我們下午的會議。

confusable.diff: interruption 多指短暫的「打斷」（如被電話打斷）；disruption 指讓整體運作被打亂、影響較大。
outage 專指電力、網路或系統的「停止供應」；disruption 範圍更廣，任何讓正常運作中斷的問題都可以用。

example.en: The strike disrupted deliveries to our stores.
example.zh: 罷工擾亂了我們門市的配送。

example.en: Loud phone calls can be disruptive in an open office.
example.zh: 在開放式辦公室裡，大聲講電話可能會造成干擾。

example.en: Please do not interrupt the speaker during the talk.
example.zh: 演講期間請不要打斷講者。

example.en: After a short interruption, the meeting started again.
example.zh: 短暫中斷之後，會議又重新開始。

extra_vocab.en: to take away an amount from a total
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，be deducted from the following month's invoice 指補償點數會從下個月的請款單中「扣掉」，而不是退現金。deduct 常用結構是 deduct A from B，用於薪資、帳單和稅務。

example.en: The company may deduct unpaid fees from your salary.
example.zh: 公司可能會從你的薪水中扣除未繳的費用。

example.en: Please deduct the cost of the damaged items from the invoice.
example.zh: 請從請款單上扣除受損商品的費用。

example.en: Business travel may qualify for a tax deduction.
example.zh: 商務差旅可能符合稅額扣除的資格。

examples.en: You can deduct travel expenses when you file your tax return.
examples.zh: 你在申報稅務時可以扣除差旅費用。

examples.en: The store will deduct ten percent if you pay in cash.
examples.zh: 如果你付現，店家會扣掉百分之十。

examples.en: Late fees will be deducted from your deposit.
examples.zh: 逾期費用會從你的押金中扣除。

confusable.diff: subtract 是數學上的「減」，強調計算；deduct 是從金額、薪資、帳單中「扣除」，用於商務與財務。
reduce 是「降低、減少」整體的量；deduct 是明確「扣掉」某個金額。

example.en: The deduction will appear on your next pay slip.
example.zh: 這筆扣款會出現在你下一張薪資單上。

example.en: Subtract the discount from the total price.
example.zh: 從總價中減去折扣。

example.en: We plan to reduce our monthly costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們打算把每月成本降低百分之十。

example.en: Regular customers receive a five percent discount.
example.zh: 老客戶可享有百分之五的折扣。

extra_vocab.en: to tell someone about a problem or danger so they can act
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，alert 是動詞，Brightline must alert the finance department 指發生中斷後必須「在二十四小時內通知」財務部。alert 比 tell 更正式，帶有「提醒對方留意並採取行動」的語感。

example.en: Please alert the team to any changes in the schedule.
example.zh: 行程若有任何變動，請通知團隊注意。

example.en: Drivers must stay alert during long business trips.
example.zh: 司機在長途出差途中必須保持警覺。

example.en: We sent a security alert to all users this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上對所有使用者發出了資安警示。

example.en: Hospitals were put on alert after the storm warning.
example.zh: 風暴警報發布後，各醫院進入戒備狀態。

examples.en: The system will alert the IT team if someone tries to log in.
examples.zh: 若有人嘗試登入，系統會通知資訊團隊。

examples.en: Please alert the manager as soon as a customer complains.
examples.zh: 只要有顧客投訴，請立刻通知經理。

examples.en: Travelers received an alert about the flight delay on their phones.
examples.zh: 旅客在手機上收到了航班延誤的通知。

examples.en: The new staff members seem alert and ready to learn.
examples.zh: 新進員工看起來機靈，也準備好要學習。

confusable.diff: warn 強調「警告」有危險或問題（如 warn about the risk）；alert 是「通知對方注意並採取行動」，語氣較中性。
notify 是正式的「通知」某事已發生或將發生；alert 多帶有緊急、需要馬上留意的意味。

example.en: The email warns users about a new virus.
example.zh: 這封電子郵件警告使用者注意一種新病毒。

example.en: We will notify you when your order ships.
example.zh: 您的訂單出貨時，我們會通知您。

example.en: You will receive a notification by email.
example.zh: 你會收到一封電子郵件通知。

example.en: The fire alarm rang during the morning meeting.
example.zh: 晨會期間，火災警報響了。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：輕量嬰兒推車新產品提案簡報

level.why: 提案簡報含 which 非限定子句、although 讓步結構、分詞與被動（was well received、has not fully recovered），並需整合市場需求、原型設計、供應商風險與建議、時程與預算等多段資訊。干擾項取自文中出現過的材質、月份與測試活動，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone. Today I would like to propose that we develop a new lightweight stroller aimed at urban families. I will begin with the market opportunity, then outline the design, and finally walk you through the timetable and budget.

First, our surveys show that parents increasingly prefer strollers that fold with one hand and weigh under seven kilograms. However, most existing models are either too heavy or too fragile to be considered durable. Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining an aluminum frame with a sleek, elegant fabric finish, which was well received in last month's focus groups.

Second, regarding production, we plan to work with our current supplier, although we must acknowledge a risk. The earthquake last spring damaged part of its plant, and its capacity has not fully recovered. To reduce our exposure, I recommend qualifying a second supplier before the launch.

Finally, the timetable. Testing will be completed by March, and mass production is expected to begin in June. The total development cost is estimated at 450,000 dollars, of which 30 percent has already been approved.

That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
items.zh:
各位早安。今天我想提議開發一款針對都會家庭的全新輕量嬰兒推車。我會先從市場機會談起，接著說明設計，最後帶大家看時程與預算。

首先，我們的調查顯示，家長越來越偏好能單手收折、重量低於七公斤的推車。然而，現有的多數款式不是太重，就是太脆弱，稱不上耐用。我們的原型機以鋁製車架搭配俐落優雅的布料表面處理，解決了這兩個疑慮，這一點在上個月的焦點團體中獲得了良好的回響。

其次，關於生產，我們打算與現有供應商合作，不過必須承認其中有風險。去年春天的地震破壞了該供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。為降低我們的風險，我建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

最後是時程。測試將在三月前完成，量產預計在六月開始。總開發成本預估為四十五萬美元，其中百分之三十已經獲得核准。

我的簡報到此結束。我很樂意回答大家的任何問題。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the presentation?
opts: To report on last month's focus group results
To announce the selection of a new supplier
To propose the development of a new product
To request additional funding for an existing product
why: 焦點團體只是用來說明原型獲得好評的佐證，並非簡報主旨。
說話者只是建議認證第二家供應商，並未宣布已選定新供應商。
正解：說話者開頭即表明要提議開發一款新的輕量嬰兒推車，其餘內容是說明市場、設計、風險與時程。
預算中只提到已有百分之三十獲得核准，並非要求為既有產品增加資金。

questions.q: What risk does the speaker mention regarding production?
opts: The supplier's production capacity has not fully recovered.
The prototype failed a safety test in March.
The focus groups disliked the fabric finish.
why: 正解：去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商部分廠房，產能尚未完全恢復。
三月是測試預計完成的時間，文中沒有說原型安全測試失敗。
文中說家長越來越偏好輕量的推車，並非偏好較重的款式。
焦點團體對布料表面處理的反應良好，並非不喜歡。

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend doing before the launch?
opts: Postponing mass production until next year
Replacing the aluminum frame with a lighter material
Conducting additional focus groups with parents
why: 文中說量產預計六月開始，並沒有建議延後到明年。
鋁製車架是原型的設計，說話者沒有建議更換。
焦點團體是上個月已經進行過的活動，說話者並未建議再增加。
正解：為降低風險，說話者建議在上市前先認證第二家供應商。

questions.q: The committee will ______ the proposal at its next meeting.
why: considerate 是形容詞，意為「體貼的」，不能接在助動詞 will 之後作動詞。
正解：will 之後接原形動詞 consider，表示委員會將審議該提案。
considerably 是副詞，不能單獨作動詞，且後面不能接受詞 the proposal。
considered 是過去式或過去分詞，不能直接接在助動詞 will 之後。

questions.q: Please direct any questions ______ the presentation to Ms. Park in the marketing department.
why: 正解：regarding 在此作介系詞，意為「關於」，後面接 the presentation。
regarded 是過去分詞，語意為「被視為」，不能直接連接 the presentation。
regards 是名詞或第三人稱單數動詞，放在此處結構與語意都不符。
regard 是原形動詞或名詞，不能直接作為介系詞來修飾 questions。

questions.q: The project manager will present the findings ______ the board of directors on Friday.
why: at 通常接地點或時間點，present the findings at the board 語意不通。
from 表示來源，語意是「來自董事會」，與簡報的對象不符。
正解：present ... to 表示向某人報告，對象是董事會。
by 表示「由……」或「在……之前」，無法表示報告的對象。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Today I would like to propose that we develop...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 今天我想提議我們開發……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報開場，直接點出提案主題，that 子句內動詞用原形。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I will begin with..., then outline..., and finally walk you through...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我會先從……開始，接著概述……，最後帶大家看……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於開場後預告簡報架構，幫助聽眾掌握順序。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our surveys show that...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的調查顯示……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明重點，引用調查或數據支持論點。

presentation_phrases.phrase: However, most existing models are either too ... or too ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 然而，現有的多數款式不是太……，就是太……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉折，指出現有產品的不足，帶出自己提案的價值。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Our prototype addresses both concerns by combining...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們的原型機透過結合……解決了這兩個疑慮
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於說明解決方案，by + 動名詞說明做法。

presentation_phrases.phrase: To reduce our exposure, I recommend...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 為降低我們的風險，我建議……
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於提出風險因應建議，帶出下一步行動。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Finally, the timetable.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 最後是時程。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於轉入最後一個重點，提示聽眾簡報即將進入尾聲。

presentation_phrases.phrase: That concludes my presentation. I would be happy to take any questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我的簡報到此結束，我很樂意回答任何問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 用於簡報結尾並開放問答，語氣禮貌且專業。

extra_vocab.en: a list that shows when things will happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the timetable 指新產品從測試到量產的「時程」，後面接著說明測試與量產的時間點。timetable 是英式用法較常見的字，美式多說 schedule，兩者在簡報中都能用。

example.en: We must stick to the timetable to finish before the holiday.
example.zh: 我們必須按照時程進行，才能在假期前完成。

example.en: The team is working to a tight timetable this quarter.
example.zh: 團隊本季的工作時程很緊湊。

example.en: The project timetable has changed because of the delay in testing.
example.zh: 由於測試延誤，專案時程表已經更動。

example.en: We need to revise the timetable after the supplier's response.
example.zh: 收到供應商的回覆後，我們需要修改時程表。

examples.en: Please review the timetable and tell me if any dates are a problem.
examples.zh: 請看一下時程表，若有任何日期有問題請告訴我。

examples.en: The train timetable shows a departure every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 火車時刻表顯示每三十分鐘有一班車出發。

examples.en: The conference timetable will be sent to all participants next week.
examples.zh: 研討會的時間表將於下週寄給所有參加者。

confusable.diff: schedule 是美式較常用的「時程、行程安排」，也可當動詞「安排」；timetable 多指列出時間的「時刻表、時程表」，英式用法較常見。
agenda 是會議的「議程」，列的是討論項目；timetable 列的是各項事情發生的時間。

example.en: We are behind schedule because of the late delivery.
example.zh: 由於延遲交貨，我們的進度落後了。

example.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
example.zh: 議程上的第一項是預算。

example.en: The deadline for the proposal is next Monday.
example.zh: 提案的截止期限是下週一。

example.en: I added the meeting to the shared calendar.
example.zh: 我把這場會議加進了共用行事曆。

extra_vocab.en: beautiful in a simple and attractive way
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，sleek, elegant fabric finish 形容推車的布料表面質感簡潔又有品味，是在強調產品的外觀賣點。elegant 在商務情境中多用來描述設計、空間或場合，有「簡單卻高雅」的正面語感。

example.en: Customers praised the elegant design of the new laptop.
example.zh: 顧客稱讚這台新筆電的設計優雅。

example.en: The engineers found an elegant solution to the heat problem.
example.zh: 工程師找到了一個簡潔巧妙的方法來解決過熱問題。

example.en: The lobby is elegantly designed and very welcoming.
example.zh: 大廳設計典雅，讓人感覺很親切。

examples.en: The brochure has an elegant layout that customers find easy to read.
examples.zh: 這本手冊的版面雅緻，顧客覺得容易閱讀。

examples.en: The hotel restaurant offers an elegant dining room for client dinners.
examples.zh: 飯店餐廳提供雅緻的用餐空間，適合招待客戶晚宴。

examples.en: She gave an elegant speech at the awards dinner.
examples.zh: 她在頒獎晚宴上發表了一場優雅得體的演說。

confusable.diff: stylish 是「時髦的、有流行感的」；elegant 是「高雅、簡潔有品味」，不一定追求流行。
luxurious 是「奢華的」，強調昂貴與豪華；elegant 強調簡潔優雅，不一定貴。

example.en: The elegance of the product made it popular in Europe.
example.zh: 這項產品的雅緻風格使它在歐洲大受歡迎。

example.en: The room was elegantly decorated for the opening event.
example.zh: 這個房間為開幕活動布置得典雅大方。

example.en: The store sells stylish bags at fair prices.
example.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售時髦的包包。

extra_vocab.en: a sudden strong shaking of the ground
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，The earthquake last spring 指去年春天的地震損壞了現有供應商的部分工廠，使產能尚未完全恢復，因此提案才建議找第二家供應商。商務文章中常用它來說明供應風險或營運中斷的原因。

example.en: A strong earthquake shook the city early this morning.
example.zh: 今天清晨一場強烈地震震動了這座城市。

example.en: Earthquake damage to the warehouse delayed all shipments this month.
example.zh: 倉庫的地震災損使本月所有貨物出貨都延遲了。

example.en: Does the company carry earthquake insurance for its main factory?
example.zh: 公司有為主要工廠投保地震險嗎？

example.en: The new office building was built to be earthquake-resistant.
example.zh: 這棟新辦公大樓是以耐震為目標興建的。

examples.en: The earthquake forced the airport to close for several hours.
examples.zh: 地震迫使機場關閉了數小時。

examples.en: Our insurance covers damage to the building caused by an earthquake.
examples.zh: 我們的保險涵蓋地震對建築物造成的損害。

examples.en: After the earthquake, many factories had to stop production for weeks.
examples.zh: 地震過後，許多工廠必須停產數週。

confusable.diff: quake 是 earthquake 的簡短說法，常見於新聞標題；正式的商務文件多用 earthquake。
disaster 是「災難」的泛稱，包含地震、水災、火災等；earthquake 只指「地震」這種災害。

example.en: The company has a plan for natural disasters.
example.zh: 公司對天然災害訂有應變計畫。

example.en: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
example.zh: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重損壞。

example.en: Sales have started to recover after the slow winter.
example.zh: 經過冷清的冬天後，銷售額開始回升。

example.en: Staff should know the exit routes in an emergency.
example.zh: 員工應該知道緊急情況下的逃生路線。

extra_vocab.en: strong and able to last a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，too fragile to be considered durable 指市面上多數推車太脆弱，稱不上耐用，這正是新產品要解決的問題之一。durable 常用來形容產品在長期使用下不易損壞。

example.en: Aluminum is a light and durable material for strollers.
example.zh: 鋁是用來製作嬰兒推車的輕巧又耐用的材料。

example.en: Sales of durable goods rose during the holiday season.
example.zh: 耐久財的銷售額在假期期間上升。

example.en: The packaging is highly durable and protects products during shipping.
example.zh: 這種包裝非常耐用，能在運送過程中保護商品。

examples.en: Customers want a durable product that will last for many years.
examples.zh: 顧客想要能使用多年的耐用產品。

examples.en: We chose steel because it is cheap and durable.
examples.zh: 我們選擇鋼材，因為它既便宜又耐用。

examples.en: Our new phone case is light yet very durable.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機殼很輕，卻非常耐用。

confusable.diff: sturdy 強調外型「結實、穩固」（如 sturdy chair）；durable 強調「長期使用不易壞」。
fragile 是反義字，指「易碎、脆弱的」；durable 是「耐用的」。

example.en: The tests showed excellent durability under heavy use.
example.zh: 測試顯示它在高強度使用下耐用性極佳。

example.en: The shelf is sturdy enough to hold heavy boxes.
example.zh: 這個架子夠結實，可以放重的箱子。

example.en: Please mark the box as fragile before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨前請在箱子上標示為易碎品。

items.tag: 大樓通道維修封閉與臨時停車安排備忘錄

level.why: 備忘錄以 After 引導的被動與 linking 分詞構句、which 非限定子句、although 讓步子句與多個被動結構，並需整合通道封閉期間、北側入口、僅限 Lot C 的費用吸收、許可證擺放與聯絡時限等資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的停車區、入口與費用細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
MEMO TO ALL STAFF: Temporary Changes to Building Access and Parking

After water damage was discovered beneath the covered walkway linking the main office tower to the parking structure, the facilities department closed the passage, which is not expected to reopen for approximately three weeks. Until repairs are completed, employees arriving from the parking structure should use the north entrance, which has been staffed during peak hours to prevent congestion.

Because the lower levels of the structure will also be partly blocked, drivers are encouraged to park in Lot C, where ample space is available. The company will absorb the daily fee charged at that lot, although employees who park elsewhere will not be reimbursed. Temporary permits will be administered by the facilities office and must be displayed on the dashboard at all times.

Staff who regularly carry heavy equipment between buildings should contact the facilities office urgently, preferably before Friday, so that alternative arrangements can be made.
items.zh:
全體員工注意：大樓進出與停車的臨時調整

在主辦公大樓與停車場之間的有頂走道下方被發現有積水損壞後，設施部門已封閉該通道，預計大約三週內不會重新開放。在維修完成之前，從停車場進入的員工應使用北側入口，該入口在尖峰時段已派人駐守，以避免擁擠。

由於停車場的低樓層也將部分封閉，我們鼓勵駕駛人改停 C 停車區，那裡有充足的空位。公司將吸收該停車區的每日費用，不過停在其他地方的員工將無法獲得報銷。臨時停車許可證將由設施辦公室負責核發，且必須隨時放置在儀表板上。

經常在大樓之間搬運重型設備的員工，應盡快與設施辦公室聯絡，最好在週五之前，以便安排替代方案。

vocab.col: absorb the cost / absorb the impact

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To announce a permanent change in the company's parking policy
To explain temporary arrangements while a passage between buildings is repaired
To ask employees to volunteer for repair work on the parking structure
To report that a new parking structure will be built near the office tower
why: 文中只說明維修期間的暫時安排（預計約三週），並未提到永久性的停車政策變更。
正解：備忘錄說明走道因積水損壞而封閉，並交代維修期間的入口、停車與許可證等臨時安排。
文中沒有徵求志願者；員工只被要求改走北側入口、改停 C 停車區或聯絡設施辦公室。
停車場是既有設施，文中只提到其低樓層將被部分封閉，並未提到要興建新的停車場。

questions.q: According to the memo, what will the company do about parking costs?
opts: Pay for employees to use any nearby parking lot
Lower the price of permits for the lower levels of the structure
Provide a free shuttle from the north entrance to Lot C
Pay the daily fee only at Lot C
why: 文中明說停在其他地方的員工不會獲得報銷，因此並非任何附近停車區都由公司負擔。
文中沒有提到調降許可證價格；低樓層只是被部分封閉，並非降價。
文中並未提到接駁車；北側入口是給從停車場進入的員工使用的入口。
正解：公司只吸收 Lot C 的每日費用（absorb the daily fee charged at that lot），在其他地方停車者不予報銷。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the north entrance?
opts: It is likely to be crowded at certain times of the day.
It has been closed until the repairs are completed.
It was used only by visitors before the walkway closed.
It is the only entrance that staff carrying equipment may use.
why: 正解：該入口在尖峰時段已派人駐守以避免擁擠（to prevent congestion），可推論尖峰時段可能會很擁擠。
北側入口是替代入口，開放給員工使用；被封閉的是走道。
文中沒有說明該入口之前的使用對象，無法推論只有訪客使用。
文中只要求搬運設備的員工聯絡設施辦公室，並未限制他們只能使用北側入口。

questions.q: ______ the elevators are being serviced, staff on the upper floors should use the east stairwell.
why: Although 表示讓步，「儘管電梯在維修，員工仍應走樓梯」語意不合邏輯。
Despite 是介系詞，後面要接名詞或動名詞，不能接完整子句。
正解：While 是連接詞，引導子句，表示「在電梯維修期間」，語意通順且文法正確。
During 是介系詞，後面要接名詞，不能直接接 the elevators are being serviced 這個子句。

questions.q: Please report any ______ damaged equipment to the facilities office by the end of the day.
why: visible 是形容詞，不能修飾 damaged（形容詞用法的分詞）；此處需要副詞。
visibility 是名詞，不能放在 any 與 damaged 之間修飾 damaged。
vision 是名詞，語意與文法都不符。
正解：visibly 是副詞，修飾形容詞 damaged，表示「明顯受損的」設備。

questions.q: The renovation, ______ was originally scheduled to end in May, has been extended by two weeks.
why: 逗號之後的非限定子句不能使用 that 作關係代名詞。
正解：which 在逗號後引導非限定關係子句，指前面的 the renovation，並在子句中作主詞。
whose 表示所有格，後面要接名詞，此處語意與結構都不通。
what 是名詞子句的連接詞，不能在逗號後修飾前面的名詞 renovation。

items.tag: 醫療客戶巡迴拜訪的公務租車與山路行車須知

level.why: 電子郵件使用 Having compared 的完成式分詞構句、which 非限定子句、Because 原因子句、unless 條件子句與 Should 開頭的倒裝條件句，並需整合異地還車免費、里程不限但燃料與停車自付、週四七點前出發及道路封閉時的通報流程；干擾項多取自文中出現過的 drop-off fee、mileage 與紙本地圖等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
To: Regional Sales Team
Subject: Rental Vehicles for the Healthcare Client Tour

Having compared several quotations, the travel office has reserved mid-size sedans for next week's tour of healthcare clients from an agency with a nationwide network of branches, which allows you to return a vehicle in any tour city without paying a drop-off fee. Mileage is unlimited, but drivers are responsible for fuel and for any parking charges incurred at client sites.

Because the mountain road between Asheville and Knoxville can become hazardous in heavy rain, we recommend leaving no later than 7:00 A.M. on Thursday unless the weather service advises otherwise. A paper map may prove handy if your navigation app loses its signal. Should the road be closed, please notify the travel office immediately so that your hotel booking can be adjusted accordingly.
items.zh:
收件人：區域業務團隊
主旨：醫療保健客戶巡迴拜訪的租車安排

比較過數份報價之後，差旅辦公室已向一家在全國設有分店網絡的租車公司，為下週拜訪醫療保健客戶的行程預訂了中型轎車，這讓您可以在巡迴行程中的任何城市還車，而不必支付異地還車費。里程數不限，但駕駛須自行負擔燃料費，以及在客戶地點產生的任何停車費用。

由於阿什維爾與諾克斯維爾之間的山路在大雨中可能變得危險，我們建議週四最晚上午七點出發，除非氣象單位另有建議。若導航應用程式收不到訊號，紙本地圖可能會派上用場。萬一道路封閉，請立即通知差旅辦公室，以便相應調整您的飯店訂房。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To compare the prices of several rental agencies
To announce a change to the tour schedule
To explain rental car arrangements and driving advice for a client tour
To ask employees to approve a travel budget
why: 報價已由差旅辦公室比較完畢（Having compared several quotations），信件目的不是比較價格。
文中沒有提到行程表有變動，只說明租車與行車建議。
正解：信件交代租車安排（車型、還車、費用負擔）與山路行車建議，主旨是租車與行車的相關說明。
文中沒有要求員工核准預算，只是通知已完成的安排。

questions.q: According to the email, what are drivers responsible for paying?
opts: Fuel and parking charges at client sites
A fee for returning the car in another city
Extra charges for each mile driven
why: 正解：drivers are responsible for fuel and for any parking charges incurred at client sites，即燃料費與客戶地點的停車費。
文中明說可在任一巡迴城市還車而不必付 drop-off fee，所以異地還車費不需支付。
文中說 Mileage is unlimited，里程不限，因此沒有按里程加收費用。
文中沒有提到保險費用，這是未被提及的資訊。

questions.q: What should drivers do if the mountain road is closed?
opts: Use a paper map to find another route to the client sites
Leave the hotel no later than 7:00 A.M. on Thursday
Return the vehicle to the nearest branch without paying a fee
Tell the travel office so their hotel booking can be adjusted
why: 紙本地圖是用於導航應用程式沒有訊號時，並不是道路封閉時的指示。
7:00 A.M. 是建議出發時間，與道路封閉時該採取的行動無關。
免費還車是指在巡迴城市中還車，與道路封閉無關，文中也沒有這項指示。
正解：Should the road be closed 之後，要求立即通知差旅辦公室，以便調整飯店訂房。

questions.q: Passengers ______ flights are canceled because of severe weather will be rebooked at no extra charge.
why: who 是主格關係代名詞，後面不能直接接 flights are canceled 這種含名詞的子句。
正解：whose 表示所有格，Passengers whose flights 意為「班機被取消的乘客」，文法與語意皆正確。
which 用於指物，不能修飾 passengers（指人）。
whom 是受格，後面通常接主詞加動詞，句型不符。

questions.q: The restaurant's new menu has been ______ received by business travelers visiting the downtown area.
why: 正解：favorably 是副詞，放在 has been 與 received 之間修飾過去分詞，表示「受到好評地被接受」。
favorable 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞形式 received。
favor 是名詞或動詞，放在此處詞性與語意都不通。
favorite 是名詞或形容詞，放在此處詞性與語意都不通。

questions.q: Travelers should confirm their reservations at least 24 hours ______ departure.
why: ahead 後面需接 of 才能引導名詞，單獨使用不能直接接 departure。
while 是連接詞，後面要接子句，不能直接接名詞 departure。
正解：prior to 是介系詞片語，意為「在…之前」，at least 24 hours prior to departure 是常見用法。
since 表示「自從」，不能用來表示出發前的時間點。

items.tag: 管理職培訓工作坊報名與導師配對語音通知

level.why: 語音公告使用 which 非限定子句、Since 原因子句、because 子句、被動語態與 who 關係子句，並需整合活動地點與時間、報名截止、攜帶作品集、導師依經驗配對與候補名單等資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的 statistics、報名與部門等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good afternoon, everyone. This is Karen Lopez from Human Resources with an announcement about the career development workshop for staff who hope to move into management. The session will be held in the auditorium, which was remodeled last spring, at ten o'clock next Thursday morning. Since seating is limited, please register through the Human Resources portal before Monday.

Participants are asked to bring a portfolio that outlines their major projects, because each of them will be paired with a mentor according to their experience. Statistics from last year's program showed that employees who completed the workshop were far more likely to be promoted within two years.

If you cannot attend, please contact me directly, and I will place you on the waiting list for the next session.
items.zh:
各位午安，我是人力資源部的凱倫．羅培茲，要向大家宣布針對有意晉升管理職的員工所舉辦的職涯發展工作坊。這場課程將於下週四上午十點在禮堂舉行，該禮堂去年春天剛重新整修過。由於座位有限，請在週一之前透過人力資源入口網站報名。

參加者請攜帶一份概述自己主要專案的作品集，因為每位參加者都會依照自身經驗與一位導師配對。去年課程的統計數據顯示，完成這場工作坊的員工在兩年內獲得晉升的可能性高出許多。

如果您無法出席，請直接與我聯絡，我會將您列入下一場課程的候補名單。

vocab.col: remodel the lobby / remodel an office

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To report this year's promotion statistics to employees
To tell interested staff about an upcoming management workshop
To announce the reopening of the remodeled auditorium
To ask experienced managers to volunteer as mentors
why: promotion statistics 只是用來說明去年課程成效的佐證，並非公告的主要目的。
正解：公告說明為有意晉升管理職的員工舉辦的職涯發展工作坊，包含時間、地點、報名與準備事項。
禮堂只是活動地點，文中提到它去年春天重新整修，但公告並非為了宣布重新開放。
文中是每位參加者會被配對一位導師，並沒有徵求經理自願擔任導師。

questions.q: What are participants asked to bring to the workshop?
opts: A list of the mentors they would prefer
A document that outlines their major projects
why: 文中說導師是依經驗配對，沒有要求參加者列出偏好的導師。
statistics 是講者引用去年課程的結果，並不是要求參加者攜帶的資料。
報名是透過入口網站完成，文中沒有要求攜帶報名確認。
正解：參加者須攜帶 a portfolio that outlines their major projects，也就是概述主要專案的作品集。

questions.q: According to the speaker, how will mentors be assigned?
opts: By drawing names at the workshop
In the order in which people register
why: 正解：each of them will be paired with a mentor according to their experience，也就是依經驗配對。
文中沒有提到抽籤，這是文中未出現的資訊。
文中沒有以部門作為配對依據，部門並未被提及。
報名順序只和座位有限、須在週一前報名有關，與導師配對的方式無關。

questions.q: Ms. Chen was promoted to senior manager in ______ of her outstanding sales record.
why: recognize 是動詞原形，放在介系詞 in 之後不符合文法。
recognizable 是形容詞，意為「可辨認的」，語意與文法都不符。
正解：in recognition of 是固定用法，意為「為了表彰…」，recognition 是名詞，放在 in 之後並接 of。
recognizing 是動名詞或現在分詞，無法與 in…of 組成這個片語。

questions.q: The company offers tuition support to employees who wish to ______ their professional skills.
why: reserve 意為「預訂、保留」，不能搭配 skills 表示提升。
正解：enhance 意為「提升、增進」，enhance professional skills 是常見搭配。
conclude 意為「結束、斷定」，與 skills 搭配語意不通。
postpone 意為「延後」，與 skills 搭配語意不通。

questions.q: Employees will be eligible for the annual bonus ______ they remain with the company until the end of the year.
why: unless 表示「除非」，會讓句意變成「除非留下，否則有資格」，邏輯不通。
although 表示讓步，「儘管留在公司」與領獎金的條件關係不符。
so that 表示目的，不能表示留任是獲得資格的條件。
正解：as long as 意為「只要」，引導條件子句，表示只要留任到年底就有資格領取獎金。

items.tag: 陶瓷馬克杯運送損壞與包裝改善要求電子郵件

level.why: 電子郵件使用 Upon inspecting 的分詞構句、even though 讓步子句、帶有 which would explain 的非限定子句、probably because of 與 to the point of being 等結構，並需整合到貨日期、缺角比例、泡棉墊較薄的推測、濕度造成紙箱與圖案問題、週五前回覆及後續訂單的條件；干擾項多取自文中出現過的紙箱、港口濕度與圖案褪色等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
To: Marcus Webb, Packaging Solutions
Subject: Damage to the Latest Shipment of Ceramic Mugs

Dear Mr. Webb,

Upon inspecting the shipment delivered on Tuesday, our warehouse team found that nearly 8 percent of the mugs had arrived with chipped edges, even though the cartons showed no visible damage. After reviewing the packing records, we suspect that the foam pads separating each layer were thinner than those specified in our contract, which would explain why the mugs shifted during transport.

In addition, several cartons had absorbed moisture, probably because of the high humidity at the port, and the printed graphics on their sides had faded to the point of being unreadable.

We would therefore appreciate a written explanation by Friday, together with a revised packaging plan. Unless the problem is resolved, we will be unable to approve any further orders.
items.zh:
收件人：馬庫斯．韋布，包裝解決方案公司
主旨：最新一批陶瓷馬克杯的損壞問題

韋布先生您好：

檢查週二送達的貨物時，我們的倉儲團隊發現，將近百分之八的馬克杯到貨時邊緣有缺角，即使紙箱外觀看不出任何明顯損壞。檢視包裝紀錄後，我們懷疑隔開每一層的泡棉墊比合約中指定的更薄，這可以解釋為何馬克杯在運輸過程中會移位。

此外，有數個紙箱吸收了濕氣，可能是因為港口濕度很高，而且箱子側面印刷的圖案已褪色到無法辨識的程度。

因此，我們希望您能在週五前提供書面說明，並附上修訂後的包裝計畫。除非問題得到解決，否則我們將無法核准任何後續訂單。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To cancel an existing contract with a packaging supplier
To confirm that a shipment arrived in good condition
To ask a supplier to explain damage and provide a revised plan
To request a lower price for future orders
why: 信中只說在問題未解決時無法核准後續訂單，並未要求取消現有合約。
信中說明貨物有缺角，並非到貨狀況良好。
正解：寄件者要求供應商在週五前提供書面說明與修訂後的包裝計畫，目的是處理貨物損壞問題。
信中沒有提到要求降價，只要求說明與改善計畫。

questions.q: What does the writer suspect caused the mugs to be chipped?
opts: The cartons were damaged while being unloaded
The foam pads were thinner than the contract required
The mugs were exposed to humid conditions at the port
The printed graphics were applied incorrectly
why: 文中說紙箱外觀沒有明顯損壞，並未提到卸貨時造成損壞。
正解：寄件者懷疑隔層的泡棉墊比合約規定的更薄，所以馬克杯在運輸時移位而缺角。
港口的高濕度造成的是紙箱吸收濕氣與圖案褪色，並不是馬克杯缺角的原因。
圖案褪色是濕氣造成的另一個問題，與馬克杯缺角無關。

questions.q: What will happen if the problem is not resolved?
opts: The mugs will be returned to the port at the supplier's expense
The contract will be canceled immediately
The warehouse team will inspect each carton again
The company will not approve additional orders
why: 文中沒有提到退貨或費用由誰負擔。
文中只說無法核准後續訂單，並未說立即取消合約。
檢查是已經完成的動作，並不是問題未解決時會發生的結果。
正解：Unless the problem is resolved, we will be unable to approve any further orders，即不會核准後續訂單。

questions.q: Had the supplier notified us earlier, we ______ the production schedule.
why: 正解：Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 是省略 if 的假設語氣（與過去事實相反），主要子句用 would have + 過去分詞。
would adjust 用於與現在事實相反的假設，時態與前句 Had notified 不一致。
had adjusted 是過去完成式，不能用在假設語氣的主要子句。
adjusted 是單純過去式，無法表達與過去事實相反的假設結果。

questions.q: The warehouse uses a barcode system to ______ every item as it moves through the facility.
why: negotiate 意為「協商」，不能搭配 item 表示追蹤物品。
postpone 意為「延後」，語意與條碼系統的用途不符。
正解：track 意為「追蹤」，用條碼系統追蹤每件貨品在設施內的移動，語意最通順。
reserve 意為「預訂、保留」，與條碼系統追蹤貨品的用途不符。

questions.q: All materials must be delivered in accordance ______ the specifications in the purchase order.
why: in accordance 的固定搭配介系詞不是 to。
正解：in accordance with 是固定用法，意為「依照、符合」，後面接規格或規定。
by 無法與 in accordance 組成固定搭配。
for 無法與 in accordance 組成固定搭配。

items.tag: 社區圖書館公益行銷活動的客服應對指引電子郵件

level.why: 電子郵件使用 Beginning 的分詞構句、a cause that 關係子句、Because 原因子句、which 非限定子句、現在完成被動（has been authorized）與 however 插入語，並需整合銷售額十分之一用於募款、部落客帶來詢問量增加、臨時人力、複述客戶問題、退款上報主管與週五培訓等資訊；干擾項多取自文中出現過的部落客、退款、臨時人員與培訓等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
To: Customer Service Team
Subject: Guidelines for the Community Library Campaign

Beginning next Monday, ten percent of every reusable bottle sold online will help us fundraise for the Riverside Community Library, a cause that our marketing team expects to attract considerable attention. Because several influential bloggers have already agreed to promote the campaign, the number of customer questions is likely to double during the first week, and temporary staff will be assigned to the phone lines accordingly.

To avoid misunderstandings, representatives are asked to paraphrase each customer's question before answering, which gives the customer a chance to correct any mistakes. Questions about refunds, however, should not be handled individually; they must be escalated to the supervisor on duty, who has been authorized to approve exceptions.

A short training session will be held on Friday at three o'clock in the main conference room.
items.zh:
收件人：客服團隊
主旨：社區圖書館公益活動的客服應對指引

從下週一開始，線上售出的每一個環保水瓶，都會將百分之十用於協助我們為河濱社區圖書館募款，行銷團隊預期這項公益訴求會吸引相當多的關注。由於數位有影響力的部落客已同意協助宣傳這項活動，第一週的客戶詢問量很可能會增加一倍，因此將相應地安排臨時人員支援電話線路。

為了避免誤解，請客服人員在回答之前先用自己的話複述每位客戶的問題，這能讓客戶有機會糾正任何誤會。不過，有關退款的問題不應由個別人員處理，必須呈報給值班主管，主管已獲授權可核准例外狀況。

週五下午三點將在大會議室舉行一場簡短的培訓課程。

vocab.col: paraphrase a question / paraphrase the message
escalate an issue / escalate to a supervisor

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To announce the results of a library fundraising event
To invite bloggers to join a promotional campaign
To request more staff for the marketing department
To explain how to handle customer contacts during a campaign
why: 信中是說活動即將開始，並非公布募款活動的成果。
部落客已經同意宣傳，信的對象是客服團隊，並不是邀請部落客。
臨時人員是信中提到的因應措施之一，但信的主旨不是向行銷部門要求增加人力。
正解：信中向客服團隊說明活動期間的應對方式，包括複述問題、退款上報與培訓時間。

questions.q: Why is the company expecting more customer questions than usual?
opts: Several influential bloggers have agreed to promote the campaign.
A new refund policy will be introduced next week.
A new phone system will be installed in the service center.
The library will open a new branch on Monday.
why: 正解：因為數位有影響力的部落客同意宣傳活動，預期第一週詢問量可能增加一倍。
文中提到退款問題要上報主管，但沒有說退款政策將改變。
文中提到的是增派臨時人員支援電話線路，並未提到安裝新電話系統。
圖書館是募款的對象，文中沒有提到它將開設新分館。

questions.q: What are representatives told to do with questions about refunds?
opts: Handle them individually to save time
Paraphrase them for the supervisor on duty
Pass them on to the supervisor on duty
Answer them only after the training session
why: 文中明說退款問題不應由個別人員處理（should not be handled individually）。
複述（paraphrase）是用來確認客戶問題的做法，並不是對主管複述退款問題。
正解：退款問題必須上報給值班主管（escalated to the supervisor on duty），由主管核准例外。
培訓課程是在週五舉行，文中沒有要求等到課後才回答退款問題。

questions.q: The marketing team was highly ______ in launching the campaign on schedule.
why: success 是名詞，不能放在 be 動詞與 in 之間作補語並接 in 的用法。
正解：be successful in + V-ing 是固定用法，successful 為形容詞，表示「在…方面成功」。
successfully 是副詞，不能放在 was 之後作補語。
succeeded 是過去式或過去分詞，與 was 連用不符文法，語意也不通。

questions.q: ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor promotion attracted hundreds of visitors.
why: Because of 表示原因，「因為大雨而吸引了數百位訪客」語意不通。
Although 是連接詞，後面要接完整子句，不能直接接 the heavy rain。
However 是副詞，用來連接前後兩個句子，不能放在句首後直接接名詞。
正解：Despite 是介系詞，後接名詞 the heavy rain，表示「儘管下大雨」，語意與文法皆正確。

questions.q: Customers who register for the loyalty program will receive ______ updates about upcoming sales.
why: 正解：regular 是形容詞，修飾名詞 updates，表示「定期的更新通知」。
regularly 是副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 updates。
regularity 是名詞，放在 receive 與 updates 之間無法修飾名詞。
regulate 是動詞，放在此處詞性不符，語意也不通。

items.tag: 第四季預算重新分配與外部稽核通知備忘錄

level.why: 備忘錄使用 Although 讓步子句、largely because 原因結構、被動語態、which 非限定子句、such as 插入語與 only if 條件句，並需整合營收下滑原因、預算轉移方向、稽核公司加入、十月三十日的文件期限與額外經費的條件；干擾項多取自文中出現過的合約、稽核、佐證文件與詳細說明理由等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
To: Department Heads
Subject: Revised Budget Allocation for the Fourth Quarter

Although revenue from advertisers fell by approximately 12 percent last quarter, largely because two major contracts were not renewed, the finance committee has decided against reducing the overall budget. Instead, funds originally reserved for print advertising will be redirected toward the advancement of our digital platform, which is expected to attract a broader range of advertisers over time.

To ensure that the revised figures are reviewed objectively, an auditing firm of international renown has been brought aboard and will examine all departmental expenses by the end of November. Department heads are therefore requested to submit supporting documents, such as invoices and signed contracts, no later than October 30. Requests for additional funding will be considered only if they are accompanied by a detailed justification.
items.zh:
收件人：各部門主管
主旨：第四季預算分配修訂

雖然上一季來自廣告主的營收下滑了約百分之十二，主要是因為兩份大型合約未續約，但財務委員會仍決定不縮減整體預算。取而代之的是，原本預留給平面廣告的資金將轉用於推進我們數位平台的發展，預期這將隨時間吸引更廣泛的廣告主。

為確保修訂後的數字能被客觀審查，我們已邀請一家享有國際聲譽的稽核公司加入，並將在十一月底前檢視各部門的所有支出。因此，請各部門主管最晚在十月三十日前，提交發票與已簽署合約等佐證文件。額外經費的申請，只有在附上詳細說明理由時才會被考慮。

vocab.zh: 廣告主、刊登廣告的客戶
加入團隊或專案；在船（車、機）上

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the memo?
opts: To announce that the overall budget will be reduced
To describe a budget change and the steps departments must take
To report the findings of an external audit
To introduce a new contract with an advertiser
why: 文中明說財務委員會決定不縮減整體預算（decided against reducing the overall budget）。
正解：備忘錄說明預算由平面廣告轉向數位平台，並要求各部門主管提交佐證文件。
稽核公司才剛加入，將在十一月底前檢視支出，文中尚無稽核結果。
文中提到的是兩份合約未續約，並沒有介紹新的廣告主合約。

questions.q: Why did revenue from advertisers decline last quarter?
opts: The finance committee reduced the budget
The audit found errors in expense reports
Two major contracts were not renewed
why: 文中提到的是預算會轉移，並未說明有平面刊物停刊。
財委會是決定不縮減整體預算，且預算調整是營收下滑之後的決定，並非原因。
稽核尚未開始，也沒有發現任何費用報告的錯誤。
正解：營收下滑主要是因為兩份大型合約未續約（two major contracts were not renewed）。

questions.q: What are department heads asked to do by October 30?
opts: Submit supporting documents for their expenses
Provide a justification for every funding request
why: 正解：各部門主管須在十月三十日前提交發票、已簽署合約等佐證文件。
詳細說明理由只有在申請額外經費時才需要，並非十月三十日前每位主管都要做的事。
稽核公司會在十一月底前檢視支出，文中沒有要求主管與其會面。
文中說的是兩份合約未續約，並沒有要求主管簽署續約。

questions.q: The contract will automatically ______ for another year unless either party gives written notice.
why: renewal 是名詞，不能放在助動詞 will 之後作動詞。
renewing 是現在分詞或動名詞，不能直接接在 will 之後。
正解：will 之後要接原形動詞，renew 表示「續約」，符合文法與語意。
renewed 是過去式或過去分詞，不能接在 will 之後。

questions.q: The accounting department is responsible ______ preparing the annual financial statements.
why: be responsible of 不是正確搭配，應使用 responsible for。
正解：be responsible for + V-ing 是固定用法，表示「負責做…」。
responsible to 是「對某人負責」，後面接人，不能接 preparing。
by 無法與 responsible 組成此處的固定搭配。

questions.q: The company has set aside funds to ______ any unexpected costs during the construction period.
why: 正解：cover 在此意為「支付、涵蓋」，cover costs 是常見搭配，表示以資金支付費用。
depart 意為「出發、離開」，不能搭配 costs。
expire 意為「到期」，是不及物動詞，不能直接接 costs。
benefit 雖可作動詞，但語意是「使受益」，與支付意外費用不符。

items.tag: 簡報／提案：全國門市舊電子產品回收計畫提案簡報

level.why: 簡報使用 which 與 whose 非限定子句、so that 目的子句、第三人稱被動、most of which 數量結構與多個轉換語，並需整合調查背景、設置時程與門市數、折價券內容、合作對象、預估參與率及成本回收方式；干擾項多取自文中出現過的問卷、回收材料販售與社區團體等細節，需精確區分。

items.passage:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me today. I would like to present our proposal for a nationwide electronics recycling program, which would allow customers to return old phones and small appliances at any of our stores.

Let me begin with the background. In last quarter's survey, customers repeatedly told us that they had no convenient way to dispose of unused devices. To paraphrase one comment, people want to do the right thing, but nobody explains how. This gap represents a clear opportunity for us.

Now, about the plan itself. First, we will install collection boxes in all 120 stores by next March. Second, each customer who returns a device will receive a voucher worth five dollars toward a future purchase. Third, the signs above the boxes will use bright, simple graphics so that shoppers understand the process at a glance.

Next, I would like to explain how we will reach the public. We propose partnering with several influential community groups, whose members are likely to share the program with their neighbors. Early estimates suggest that participation could reach 30 percent of our regular customers within a year.

Finally, the total cost will be approximately 85,000 dollars, most of which will be recovered through the sale of recycled materials. Thank you for listening, and I would be glad to take your questions.
items.zh:
各位早安，感謝大家今天撥冗參加。我想向各位提出我們的全國性電子產品回收計畫提案，這個計畫將讓顧客可以在我們任何一家門市歸還舊手機與小型家電。

讓我先從背景說起。在上一季的調查中，顧客一再告訴我們，他們沒有方便的方式來處理不用的裝置。借用其中一則意見的說法，大家都想做對的事，但沒有人告訴他們該怎麼做。這個缺口對我們來說是明確的機會。

接著談計畫本身。第一，我們將在明年三月之前，於全部一百二十家門市設置回收箱。第二，每位歸還裝置的顧客，都會收到一張價值五美元、可用於下次購物的折價券。第三，回收箱上方的標示將使用鮮明簡單的圖案設計，讓購物者一眼就能了解流程。

接下來，我想說明我們要如何觸及大眾。我們建議與幾個有影響力的社區團體合作，其成員很可能會向鄰居分享這項計畫。初步估計顯示，一年內參與率有機會達到我們一般顧客的百分之三十。

最後，總成本大約是八萬五千美元，其中大部分將透過販售回收材料來回收。感謝各位的聆聽，我很樂意回答大家的問題。

vocab.col: dispose of waste / dispose of properly
vocab.zh: 處理、丟棄（常用 dispose of）

vocab.col: paraphrase a comment / paraphrase the question

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the presentation?
opts: To report the results of a customer survey
To announce the closing of some stores
To propose a program for returning old electronic devices
To explain how recycled materials are sold
why: 問卷調查只是用來說明背景與需求，並不是簡報的主要目的。
文中沒有提到要關閉任何門市，而是要在所有門市設置回收箱。
正解：講者提案推出全國性的電子產品回收計畫，讓顧客在門市歸還舊裝置。
回收材料的販售只在最後說明成本回收時順帶提到，並非主旨。

questions.q: How will customers be encouraged to return their devices?
opts: They will receive a voucher toward a future purchase.
They will receive a free replacement device.
They will be entered into a prize draw.
They will receive a discount on repair services.
why: 正解：每位歸還裝置的顧客會收到價值五美元、可用於下次購物的折價券。
文中沒有提到免費提供替換裝置。
文中沒有提到抽獎活動，這是未被提及的資訊。
文中沒有提到維修服務的折扣，折價券是用於未來購物。

questions.q: How does the speaker expect the cost of the program to be handled?
opts: A government grant will cover most of it.
Customers will pay a small recycling fee.
Partner community groups will share the expense.
Most of it will be recovered by selling recycled materials.
why: 文中沒有提到政府補助，這是未被提及的資訊。
文中沒有向顧客收取回收費，顧客反而可以拿到折價券。
社區團體只負責協助宣傳，文中沒有說他們會分擔費用。
正解：總成本約八萬五千美元，其中大部分將透過販售回收材料來回收。

questions.q: The presentation was so ______ that several managers asked for copies of the slides.
why: inform 是動詞，不能放在 so 之後作形容詞補語。
正解：informative 是形容詞，so informative that 表示「資訊豐富到…」，符合文法與語意。
informatively 是副詞，不能放在 was 之後作補語。
information 是名詞，不能放在 so 之後，且語意不通。

questions.q: Please send me the final figures ______ the meeting begins so that I can review them.
why: during 是介系詞，後面要接名詞，不能接 the meeting begins 這個子句。
unless 表示「除非」，語意與「讓我先審閱」不合邏輯。
正解：before 是連接詞，表示「在會議開始之前」，後接子句且語意通順。
although 表示讓步，與前後句的目的關係不合。

questions.q: The committee will ______ the proposal carefully before announcing its decision.
why: 正解：review 意為「審查」，review the proposal 是常見搭配，且是及物動詞。
depart 意為「出發」，是不及物動詞，不能直接接 proposal。
belong 意為「屬於」，是不及物動詞，不能直接接 proposal。
reply 意為「回覆」，是不及物動詞，後面需要接 to，不能直接接 proposal。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I would like to present our proposal for ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我想向各位提出我們的…提案
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報開場，說明這次要報告的主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me begin with the background.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我先從背景說起。
presentation_phrases.usage: 進入第一個主要段落，說明問題或需求的來由。

presentation_phrases.phrase: To paraphrase one comment, ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 借用其中一則意見的說法，…
presentation_phrases.usage: 轉述客戶或同事的話時使用，用自己的話重述重點。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Now, about the plan itself.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接著談計畫本身。
presentation_phrases.usage: 從背景轉換到具體做法，提示聽眾主題的轉換。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, ... Second, ... Third, ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 第一，…第二，…第三，…
presentation_phrases.usage: 依序說明計畫的多個重點，讓條理清楚。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Next, I would like to explain how ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接下來，我想說明如何…
presentation_phrases.usage: 轉到下一個要點，用來引出下一段說明。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Early estimates suggest that ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 初步估計顯示…
presentation_phrases.usage: 引用尚未定案的預估數字，語氣保留彈性。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I would be glad to take your questions.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我很樂意回答大家的問題。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報結尾，邀請聽眾提問。
